controversy_hook.primary_harm_thesis: dilution of local constituent voice via concentrated ideological/outside Super PAC bundlers

vote.question: [US-SD - U.S. Senate]: Mike Rounds (R) has received $9,957,529 in career campaign contributions (with $3,810,748 this cycle, alongside $1,215,086 in outside Super PAC support led by South Dakota Conservative PAC)—linked to "Outside Super PAC & Megadonor Swarm". Do you vote to formally rebuke Mike Rounds for prioritizing private donor interests & failing to represent his constituents by upholding his core civic duties?
vote.futarchy_thesis: Elected stewards are entrusted with representing citizens, yet Mike Rounds has amassed $9,957,529 in career contributions (with $3,810,748 this cycle, alongside $1,215,086 in outside Super PAC support led by South Dakota Conservative PAC)—prioritizing private corporate donors over constituent interests. This civic vote allows citizens to formally censure Mike Rounds on the public ledger and direct 100% of the civic action escrow pool to local community restitution.

outcomes.YES_RELEASE_TO_LOCAL_CHARITIES: Directs 100% of the funds to verified local non-profits working directly on state community needs.

futarchy_pole_mechanics.leverage_ratio_statement: Every contribution directly empowers community-led funding. Once the campaign pool reaches $10,000, an automatic 60-day countdown begins. When the 60 days expire, all funds go directly to verified local charities or essential community services—zero platform cut.

bounty_if_passed.description: Community Fund for US-SD: Delivers 100% of funds to verified, IRS-registered 501(c)(3) public charities serving SD dedicated to non-partisan civic accountability, investigative public-interest journalism, and voter legal defense. Verified local recipients: EAST RIVER LEGAL SERVICES CORPORATION (US-EIN:237101054); PUBLIC RADIO NEWS DIRECTORS INC (US-EIN:223202714); SIOUX FALLS AREA COURT APPOINTED SPECIAL ADVOCATE PROGRAM (US-EIN:460430647); FIRST CIRCUIT COURT APPOINTED SPECIAL ADVOCATE PROGRAM (US-EIN:460462671); SOUTH DAKOTA NEWS WATCH (US-EIN:814674814). Once the pool hits $10,000, a 60-day timer starts. If YES wins, funds go to these charities; if NO wins, funds go to local community commons (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
bounty_if_passed.destination_criteria: All recipient organizations must be active, verified 501(c)(3) public charities registered in US-SD with clean IRS status and direct community impact. Approved charities: EAST RIVER LEGAL SERVICES CORPORATION (US-EIN:237101054); PUBLIC RADIO NEWS DIRECTORS INC (US-EIN:223202714); SIOUX FALLS AREA COURT APPOINTED SPECIAL ADVOCATE PROGRAM (US-EIN:460430647); FIRST CIRCUIT COURT APPOINTED SPECIAL ADVOCATE PROGRAM (US-EIN:460462671); SOUTH DAKOTA NEWS WATCH (US-EIN:814674814).

trigger_conditions: Condition 1 (Activation): The campaign activates its 60-day countdown timer as soon as total contributions reach $10,000 USD (Base USDC).
Condition 2 (Resolution Period): The community vote runs for exactly 60 days from the moment the $10,000 threshold is reached.

Condition 3 (Payout): If YES receives 60% or more of votes, 100% of the funds are sent to the verified state non-profits; otherwise, 100% is sent to universal community services (fire/EMS, veterans, food banks).
